name: DocumentViewer
label: Document viewer
description: A PDF, an image or a text file shown on the page, with download and a fallback where the browser will not embed it.

props.name: src
props.description: The file's address.

props.name: title
props.description: The document's name, shown in the toolbar and naming the frame for a screen reader. Note: this replaces the native `title` tooltip attribute, which DocumentViewer does not expose.

props.name: kind
props.description: How to show it, or `auto` to read it from `fileName`, `src` and `mimeType`. A kind the viewer cannot show renders the fallback. Defaults to `auto`.

props.name: fileName
props.description: The file's name, extension included, for `auto` and for the downloaded file. Defaults to the last part of `src`.

props.name: mimeType
props.description: The file's mime type, when `auto` cannot tell from the name.

props.name: height
props.description: The viewer's height: `default`, `tall`, or `fill` to take the height of its container.

props.name: bare
props.description: Drop the frame and the toolbar and fill the host, for a host that brings its own header with the name and the actions, such as AttachmentViewer.

props.name: download
props.description: Show the download button. A string names the downloaded file. Defaults to true.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called when the download button is pressed, in place of the browser's own download: for a file the host must fetch with credentials.

props.name: openInNewTab
props.description: Show the button that opens the file in a new tab. Defaults to true.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: More controls for the toolbar, before the built-in ones: a share button, a page count.

props.name: fallback
props.description: What shows when the file cannot be shown here: an unknown kind, a text file that would not load, or a browser that will not embed a PDF. Defaults to a line saying so and a download button.

props.name: downloadLabel
props.description: Accessible name and text of the download button. Defaults to "Download".

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the open button. Defaults to "Open in new tab".

props.name: zoomInLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the zoom-in button. Defaults to "Zoom in".

props.name: zoomOutLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the zoom-out button. Defaults to "Zoom out".

props.name: resetZoomLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button that fits an image to the width again, given the zoom in percent. Defaults to "Fit to width, now <zoom>%".

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Announced while a text file loads. Defaults to "Loading document".

props.name: fallbackLabel
props.description: The default fallback's line. Defaults to "This file can’t be shown here."
props.default: This file can’t be shown here.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the zoom is written in. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes
